assertions.expected: Pi 1.1.0 loads the actual package extension and registers gstack-bridge:status and gstack-bridge:doctor.
assertions.observed: get_commands returned gstack-bridge:status and gstack-bridge:doctor from a live Pi RPC host.

assertions.expected: The registered gstack_pi_agent tool launches a real Pi child; its result is returned as a handled tool response and observed by the parent model.
assertions.observed: The tool result contained PI_GSTACK_SMOKE_CHILD_OK; child exit_code=0; parent response contained PARENT_OBSERVED_BRIDGE_CHILD_OK.

assertions.expected: An empty task is handled by the real extension as a non-error tool result; Pi remains responsive and the parent observes that result.
assertions.observed: tool_execution_end isError=false with "No child task was provided."; parent response contained PARENT_OBSERVED_HANDLED_ERROR.

assertions.expected: After clean shutdown, a second actual Pi process reloads the extension and registers its bridge command.
assertions.observed: Second Pi process get_commands returned gstack-bridge:status and gstack-bridge:doctor.

assertions.expected: The reloaded extension in the second actual Pi process executes gstack_pi_agent, receives a successful actual child Pi response, and returns it to the parent.
assertions.observed: Second process tool result contained PI_GSTACK_SMOKE_RELOADED_OK, child exit_code=0; parent response contained PARENT_OBSERVED_RELOADED_CHILD_OK.

assertions.expected: Both sequential Pi RPC processes exit naturally with status 0 after stdin close; neither is killed to satisfy the check and no extension/unhandled/shutdown errors are observed.
assertions.observed: First process exit=0; second process exit=0; extension load errors=0; unhandled/shutdown errors=0.

assertions.expected: The actual bridge child executes the installed Pi 1.1.0 CLI through process.execPath with shell=false and returns a handled feature response; on Windows this bypasses pi.cmd.
assertions.observed: win32: executable=node.exe, cli=node_modules/@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent/dist/cli.js, shell=false; child response contained PI_GSTACK_SMOKE_RELOADED_OK.
